title: 6 of 9 Won't Name the Cap
caption:
I pay for two of these and still can't tell you what either one actually gives me.

LimitDex re-read 9 vendors, 37 plans, on Oct 18: only Copilot, Bolt and Lovable publish an allowance you can plan against. Anthropic names a five-hour limit and a weekly limit, then prints no figure for either. Cursor sells Premium as 4x of a Plus number it never published.

Honest admission: I have never hit a wall and known beforehand how close I was. I budget by vibes and get surprised.

Which tool surprised you?
